shortDescription: Configure High Availability for BIG-IP Next instances.

options.name: active_node_control_plane_ip
options.description: The HA control plane IP address on active node.

options.name: active_node_data_plane_ip
options.description: The HA data plane IP address on active node.

options.name: active_node_ip
options.description: The designated active Next instance management IP.

options.name: control_plane_vlan
options.description: The VLAN for the HA control plane.

options.name: control_plane_vlan_tag
options.description: The tag for the HA control plane VLAN. If not defined the 0 tag is assumed.

options.name: data_plane_vlan
options.description: The VLAN for the HA data plane.

options.name: data_plane_vlan_tag
options.description: The tag for the HA control plane VLAN. If not defined the 0 tag is assumed.

options.name: ha_ip
options.description: The desired management IP of the HA cluster.

options.name: ha_name
options.description: The name of the High Availability (HA) cluster.

options.name: standby_node_control_plane_ip
options.description: The HA control plane IP address on standby node.

options.name: standby_node_data_plane_ip
options.description: The HA data plane IP address on standby node.

options.name: standby_node_ip
options.description: The designated standby Next instance management IP.

options.name: timeout
options.description: The amount of time to wait for the HA creation task to finish, in seconds. The accepted value range is between C(10) and C(1800) seconds.
